CP26/32 on fractional shares, crypto venue deferrals, and eight Handbook fixes closes 12 October 2026, so it's open for just a few more days.

CP26/30 on equity market transparency and the SI regime closes 16 October 2026, also still open.

The SIPP due diligence consultation, CP26/20, closed back on 24 August 2026, so that one's shut.
